newsitem.title: CHINA: ADB seen to loan China $3.7 billion to 1999.
newsitem.headline: ADB seen to loan China $3.7 billion to 1999.

text.p: The Asian Development Bank (ADB) is expected to extend loans totalling $3.7 billion to China from 1997 to 1999, the China Daily Business Weekly said on Sunday.

The loans would be used mainly on development projects in central and western regions to reduce the gap between backward inland provinces and booming coastal areas, the newspaper said, quoting a Chinese central bank official.
Of about 30 potential projects, half would be in inland provinces, the official said, adding that inland projects would increase.
The 30 projects would be mainly in energy and transportation, it said.

Since China joined the ADB in 1986, the bank has extended loans totalling $6.38 billion for 68 Chinese projects and granted more than $100 million worth of technical assistance for 234 Chinese projects.
China has been the largest borrower of the Manila-based bank for the past three years.
